# NorthCinder

NorthCinder is an open-source, buyer-loyal shopping-agent MCP server.

Source: https://github.com/jdshfhds/northcinder
Documentation: https://github.com/jdshfhds/northcinder#readme
Ranking specification: https://github.com/jdshfhds/northcinder/blob/main/docs/RANKING.md
Trust specification: https://github.com/jdshfhds/northcinder/blob/main/docs/TRUST.md
Security reports: https://github.com/jdshfhds/northcinder/security/advisories/new

## Product contract

1. Ranking inputs are buyer criteria, never seller payment.
2. Sponsored offers are labeled and rank below organic offers.
3. Checkout requires a signed, single-use, per-purchase human approval.
4. Recommendations include machine-readable reasons persisted locally.
5. Missing merchant history is `unknown`; only deny-grade evidence produces `flagged`.
6. Raw payment-card fields are rejected.
7. The repository owner operates no NorthCinder endpoint, account system, telemetry, or control plane.

NorthCinder's ranking is deterministic and auditable over the inputs it receives. That does not prove an
upstream catalog is complete or that every store-supplied label is correct.
